name: cure-agent-budget
description: Caps how many subagents one session runs at once, tracked by agent id from spawn to completion. Optional research routing to a model alias, off by default. Adds /agents-budget.

maxConcurrent.title: Max concurrent subagents
maxConcurrent.description: How many subagents this session may run at once. 0 turns the cap off; other values are held to 1..64.

routeResearchTo.title: Route research subagents to
routeResearchTo.description: Off: every subagent runs on its own or the session's model. Otherwise a research-shaped subagent that names no model, under an Opus session, runs on this alias.
